5083754.note: Flournoy caught two of three targets for 53 yards during Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts.

5085024.name: CJ Williams
5085024.note: Williams (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Titans.

5092508.name: Colbie Young
5092508.note: Young went without a target while playing 19 of the Bengals' 74 snaps on offense in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.

5097554.name: Kameron Johnson
5097554.note: Johnson played all 17 of his snaps on special teams and recorded one tackle in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

5123663.name: Isaac TeSlaa
5123663.note: TeSlaa caught two of five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle.

5150247.name: Malik Benson
5150247.note: Benson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

5151948.name: Joey Aguilar
5151948.note: Aguilar (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Rams on Sunday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

5155179.name: Jacob De Jesus
5155179.note: The Chiefs elevated De Jesus from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

5155825.name: Carter Runyon
5155825.note: The Raiders elevated Runyon from their practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

5220680.name: Ted Hurst III
5220680.note: Hurst failed to haul in his lone target during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

8439.name: Aaron Rodgers
8439.note: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
